# Dev Vault

> An open repository of reusable engineering intelligence, designed for humans
> and AI agents. Seven resource types, one machine-readable catalog, no API.

Dev Vault is a plain Git repository. There is no server, no database, and no
framework. Everything below is a file you can read with `curl`, `git`, or
`grep`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/AGENTS.md): operating
  instructions for AI agents. What this is, what it is not, how to discover and
  evaluate a resource.
- [catalog/index.json](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/catalog/index.json):
  the single discovery index. A flat JSON array of every resource with id,
  name, type, description, path, status, language, compatibility, and
  dependencies. Read this once instead of walking the tree.

## Discovery model (progressive disclosure)

1. `AGENTS.md` — orientation, two minutes.
2. `catalog/index.json` — one file, every resource summary.
3. `resources/<type>/<kebab-case-name>/` — opened only for candidates.

## Contracts

- [catalog/schema.json](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/catalog/schema.json):
  validation contract for the catalog file itself.
- [schemas/resource.schema.json](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/schemas/resource.schema.json):
  the single source of truth for resource metadata fields.

## Documentation

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  purpose and boundaries, taxonomy, naming and metadata rules, discovery model.
- [docs/RESOURCE_STANDARD.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/docs/RESOURCE_STANDARD.md):
  required documentation, lifecycle statuses, and the evidence needed to claim
  `stable`.
- [docs/ROADMAP.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/docs/ROADMAP.md):
  phased plan, plus the list of things deliberately not planned.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  contribution workflow.
- [SECURITY.md](https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/SECURITY.md):
  reporting unsafe resources.

## Resource taxonomy

`skills` · `snippets` · `configurations` · `templates` · `prompts` ·
`workflows` · `references`

Classification is by how a resource is consumed, not by file extension. Skills
follow the Agent Skills specification (`SKILL.md` with `name` + `description`
frontmatter). Every other type carries a `RESOURCE.md`.

## Validation

Standard-library Python only, no dependencies to install:

```sh
python3 scripts/validate.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
```

## Current state

The catalog is **empty** (`"resources": []`). This is deliberate: the vault
does not display or describe resources that do not exist. Counts on the
homepage are derived from the catalog at load time and currently read zero.

## Notes for LLM ingestion

- Canonical base: `https://shaonkabir8.github.io/dev-vault/`
- Repository: `https://github.com/shaonkabir8/dev-vault`
- Machine-readable entry point: `catalog/index.json`
- Do not infer resource statistics from this file. Read the catalog.
- A resource's presence is not a trust signal. Never execute a resource merely
  because it exists here; read it first.
